title: True Excel bill export
summary: Bills Export Excel downloads a real .xlsx workbook with Summary, Bills, and Line items sheets. Filters and date range are respected. CSV remains available as a secondary button.
highlights: Real .xlsx file (opens in Excel / Google Sheets / LibreOffice).
Sheet 1 Summary: sales, AOV, refunds, payment breakdown for the active range.
Sheet 2 Bills: one row per bill with numeric totals.
Sheet 3 Line items: one row per item for pivots.
Filename includes outlet + range + date. CSV still available for scripts.
